Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

city — a large town. Example: I live in a big city.
town — a place smaller than a city. Example: My town is small.
street — a road with houses or shops. Example: The streets are clean.
building — a structure with walls and a roof. Example: The building is old.
park — a public green place in a town. Example: There are two parks near my building.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• My neighbourhood is ...
• There are ... near my building.
• I like my city because ...
• The streets are clean.
• It is a friendly place.
